{'text': 'Apple 剛剛度過一個豐盛的 9 月，但據多項傳聞，10 月將有多款令人期待已久的產品即將發佈，勢必延續強勁勢頭。', 'source': '[0] Apple just had a bountiful September, but multiple rumors suggest October is shaping up to deliver several long-awaited products to keep the momentum going.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '#1：MacBook Pro / Ultra 觸控屏幕全新設計', 'source': '[1] #1: MacBook Pro / Ultra Touch Screen New Design', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'Mac 一直是觸控屏幕的「拒絕者」，但這個局面終於有望改變，預計 10 月將推出全新 MacBook Pro（或 MacBook Ultra）。', 'source': '[2] Mac has long been the "holdout" for touch screens, but that may finally be about to change, with an all-new MacBook Pro (or MacBook Ultra) reportedly coming in October.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'Apple 新一代 MacBook Pro 將採用全新的工業設計，是五年以來首次大規模改版。除了支援觸控之外，更將配備 OLED 顯示器、Dynamic Island，並可能提供 C2 蜂窩網絡數據機選項。', 'source': "[3] Apple's next-generation MacBook Pro will feature an all-new industrial design, marking the first major overhaul in five years. In addition to touch support, it will also sport an OLED display, Dynamic Island, and potentially offer a C2 cellular modem option.", 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'MacBook Pro 已經很久沒有換上新面貌，但 Mac 拒絕加入觸控屏幕的時間更為漫長。我十分期待看到觸控功能如何提升 Mac 的使用體驗。', 'source': "[4] It's been a long time since the MacBook Pro received a fresh new look, but Mac's refusal to embrace touch screens has gone on even longer. I'm eager to see how touch capability enhances the Mac experience.", 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '#2：新一代 Apple TV 4K', 'source': '[5] #2: New Apple TV 4K', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'Apple TV 硬件從未試過像現在這樣長時間沒有更新，而現時等待新機的時間更屬史上最長。Apple 上一款型號——第三代 Apple TV 4K——於 2022 年推出。', 'source': "[6] Apple TV hardware has never gone this long without an update, and the wait for a new model is currently the longest in its history. Apple's previous model—the third-generation Apple TV 4K—launched back in 2022.", 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '有傳聞指出，我們終於有望在 10 月迎來新一款 Apple TV 4K，最大亮點是搭載強勁的 A19 或 A19 Pro 處理器，並支援 Siri AI 功能。', 'source': '[7] Rumors indicate we may finally see a new Apple TV 4K arrive in October, with the standout feature being a powerful A19 or A19 Pro processor and support for Siri AI capabilities.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'Apple 今夏調高了大部分產品的售價，Apple TV 亦在加價之列。這部已有四年歷史的 Apple TV 4K 現售 199 美元，遠高於當初開售時的 129 美元。希望新機價格不會再向上調整。', 'source': "[8] Apple raised prices on most of its products this summer, and the Apple TV was among those that got hit with a price hike. This now four-year-old Apple TV 4K is priced at $199, which is significantly higher than the $129 it originally launched at. Hopefully the new model doesn't see another price increase.", 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '#3：「HomePad」', 'source': '[9] #3: "HomePad"', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '配備屏幕的 HomePod 傳聞流傳已久，差不多與 HomePod 本身同齡。不過相關消息在 2024 年急速升溫，Mark Gurman 發表了一份深入報告，講述這款普遍被稱為「HomePad」的產品。', 'source': '[10] Rumors of a HomePod with a screen have circulated for nearly as long as the HomePod itself. However, the buzz picked up significantly in 2024 when Mark Gurman published an in-depth report detailing what is commonly being referred to as the "HomePad."', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '由 Billy Coker 發表的最多讚好留言', 'source': '[11] Top Comment By Billy Coker', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '講真，在新機真正推出之前，我不想再睇到任何 Apple TV 相關嘅文章。永遠都係「即將推出」、「即將推出」，但從來都唔見影。', 'source': '[12] Honestly, I don\'t want to see any more Apple TV articles until the new one actually comes out. It\'s always "coming soon," "coming soon," but it never materializes.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': 'HomePad 是一款內置揚聲器的智能顯示屏，據報將會肩負起 Apple 重返智能家居市場的重任。它將運行一套新作業系統，外觀融合 iOS、tvOS 及 watchOS 的元素，並設有類似 StandBy 的模式。', 'source': "[13] The HomePad is a smart display with built-in speakers that's reportedly tasked with Apple's reentry into the smart home market. It will run a new operating system with an appearance that blends elements of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS, and features a StandBy-like mode.", 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '預計 Siri AI 將會成為產品的核心功能，同時配備鏡頭、可自訂小工具，以及內置《相片》、《備忘錄》、《音樂》、《日曆》等 Apple 應用程式。', 'source': '[14] Siri AI is expected to be a core feature, along with a camera, customizable widgets, and built-in Apple apps like Photos, Notes, Music, and Calendar.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}

{'text': '10 月以至之後推出的眾多 Apple 新產品中，你最期待哪一款？歡迎留言告訴我們。', 'source': '[15] Which of the many new Apple products coming in October and beyond are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.', 'source_lang': 'en', 'target': 'zh-Hant-HK'}
